description: This file defines a React component for a client-side file ingestion UI, including file upload cards, file preview list, and LinkedIn connection toggle. It manages UI state for file uploads and interactions but does not include backend API calls.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Converts a byte count into a human-readable string with appropriate units.

methods.name: getFileExtLabel
methods.description: Extracts and returns the file extension label from a filename.

methods.name: categoryLabel
methods.description: Returns the display label for a given upload category.

methods.name: categoryTitle
methods.description: Returns the title text for a given upload category.

methods.name: categoryAccent
methods.description: Returns the accent color associated with an upload category.

methods.name: acceptString
methods.description: Returns the string of accepted file types for upload input.
